$comment: The one visual style for every video. Decided 2026-10-07 from generated test frames; see the planning doc, House style.
name: flat-detailed
styleText: Flat vector illustration, detailed. Limited palette: one background, one ink, four accent hues. Simple geometric forms, no outlines, no gradients except for light and glow, generous negative space. Every frame has a subject with an idea in it and at least two supporting details. No text, no labels; those are composited programmatically.

referenceFrames.$comment: Hedra asset ids of the two reference images every generation call carries. Pick by background.

voice.$comment: House narrator. elevenlabs-v3 for expressive delivery (audio tags chosen per scene and checked word for word); multilingual-v2 (steadier, predictable pace) when v3 refuses. Word timing comes from transcription, so v3's pace variance no longer matters for captions.
voice.name: David O.
